fix: add short, noisy and stereo buffer cases to the loop-window test

defect: fetch always returns ok:true: engine-sample/music 404 and offline (named in the file header) are never simulated; AudioContext constructor throw and resume() rejection are untested
impact: an offline or blocked-autoplay player could get a stalled or silent session unguarded
fix: make the fake fetch return 404/reject per URL; add ctor-throw and resume-reject cases

defect: apex26.volMusic/volSfx/tune load-from-localStorage parsing is stubbed to null in audio-tune; only the audio-smoke clamp test covers it
impact: a corrupt saved volume or tune value could break boot audio unguarded at unit level
fix: seed the localStorage stub with valid, out-of-range and corrupt values and assert the parsed state
